description: C.6 -- capture STOP Save-As modal with the ffwb-domain default. On CAPTURE STOP the session still stops (Req 7.6) and, when a non-empty collection exists, a modal Save-As overlay opens: it NAMES the session (pre-filled from the collection name), DEFAULTS the save location to scrm_dir() = <User_Data_Dir>/screen-collections/ (the discoverable ffwb-domain captures dir, editable so the user can navigate away), and lets the user choose the output TYPE (native .ffscrm archive AND an export type: TEXT, Markdown, HTML, PDF now; ODT/ODP deferred/greyed or omitted). On SAVE the modal INVOKES the EXISTING CAPTURE SAVE / CAPTURE EXPORT verbs through the single front door (command parity, Req 24.4) -- no new persistence path; the existing HTML/PDF exporters already embed the bitmap alongside selectable text where supported (Req 24.3). On CANCEL the capture stays stopped but nothing is written (Req 24.5). The Save-As is a MODAL overlay (not a Workspace Context), consistent with the existing dialog pattern (Req 24.6 modal branch); full dialog-capture is Phase 2E and out of scope.
steps: In crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/state_groups.rs add a grouped ScrmUiState sub-struct with `save_as: Option<SaveAsState>` (mirror SnapshotState/FocusState style) and wire it onto the shell in shell/state.rs with an accessor if needed. SaveAsState holds: name buffer, directory buffer (String, pre-filled from scrm_dir()), and an output-type enum (Ffscrm, Text, Markdown, Html, Pdf).

In crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/commands_scrm.rs change handle_capture's STOP arm to call self.scrm.stop() then, when a non-empty active collection exists, open the modal (set scrm_ui.save_as = Some(SaveAsState::new(default_name, scrm_dir()))); when there is no collection, keep the current status message and open no modal.

Create crates/ff-desktop/src/scrm_save_as_dialog.rs with SaveAsState + a render(ctx, &mut SaveAsState) -> Outcome modal modelled on about_dialog::render and the RESET BARE egui::Modal in update_dialogs.rs: name field, editable directory field, output-type selector, Save/Cancel buttons.

In crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/update_dialogs.rs::render_overlays add a guarded block (if scrm_ui.save_as.is_some()) that calls the new render fn; on SAVE build the path from name+dir and dispatch the matching EXISTING verb via self.handle_command: Ffscrm -> `CAPTURE SAVE <path>`; Text/Markdown/Html/Pdf -> `CAPTURE EXPORT <FMT> <path>`; then clear save_as.
On Cancel / Escape / dimmed-background click, clear scrm_ui.save_as and write nothing (Req 24.5).

Register `mod scrm_save_as_dialog;` alongside the existing scrm_viewer_panel/about_dialog module declarations. Keep commands_scrm.rs and update_dialogs.rs under 400 non-test lines (render body lives in the new module).
acceptance_criteria: CAPTURE STOP with a non-empty collection opens the Save-As modal; CAPTURE STOP with no collection opens no modal and keeps the status message.
The Save-As directory field defaults to scrm_dir() and is editable (owner directive: discoverable ffwb-domain default, navigable away).
SAVE with .ffscrm dispatches `CAPTURE SAVE <path>` and SAVE with PDF dispatches `CAPTURE EXPORT PDF <path>` through the front door; the file lands under a TempDir dir_overrides.scrm in tests.
CANCEL writes nothing but the capture is stopped (Req 24.5).
No new persistence path is introduced; saving/exporting reuses handle_capture_save / handle_capture_export (Req 24.4).
findings:
IMPLEMENTED FEAT-002 (capture-STOP Save-As modal). Files: NEW crates/ff-desktop/src/scrm_save_as_dialog.rs (SaveAsState + OutputType {Ffscrm,Text,Markdown,Html,Pdf} + Outcome {Open,Save,Cancel} + render(ctx,&mut SaveAsState)->Outcome egui::Modal); NEW crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/update_dialogs_scrm.rs (WorkbenchShell::render_scrm_save_as_overlay, split out to keep update_dialogs.rs under 400 lines); edited main.rs (mod scrm_save_as_dialog), shell/mod.rs (mod update_dialogs_scrm), shell/state_groups.rs (ScrmUiState.save_as: Option<SaveAsState>), shell/commands_scrm.rs (STOP arm -> new handle_capture_stop: stops session then opens modal only when active collection is NON-EMPTY), shell/update_dialogs.rs (render_overlays calls render_scrm_save_as_overlay), shell/tests_scrm.rs (6 new integration tests).

KEY WIRING for later features: (1) The modal is held at self.scrm_ui.save_as (grouped sub-struct, NOT a flat WorkbenchShell field). (2) SaveAsState::save_command() builds the EXISTING front-door string: Ffscrm->'CAPTURE SAVE <path>', Text->'CAPTURE EXPORT TEXT', Markdown->'CAPTURE EXPORT MD', Html->'CAPTURE EXPORT HTML', Pdf->'CAPTURE EXPORT PDF'. SAVE dispatches via self.handle_command(&command) -- NO new persistence path (Req 24.4). (3) output_path() joins directory+name and avoids doubling the extension. (4) Default dir = self.scrm_dir() (test override via dir_overrides.scrm). Default name = collection.name. (5) CANCEL/Escape/dimmed-click clears save_as and writes nothing (Req 24.5); the in-memory collection remains (ScrmSession::stop does not discard). (6) handle_capture_stop gates the modal on active_collection().filter(|c| !c.is_empty()) -- an active-but-empty collection opens NO modal. (7) Stable egui ids exposed: scrm_save_as_dialog::name_field_id() / dir_field_id() for any future first-Tab/focus test (modal, not a Context, so no InteriorFocus contract required per context.json). (8) ODT/ODP deliberately omitted from OutputType::ALL (Req 24.2 deferred). (9) The modal sets self.modal_open=true while open (consistent with other overlays' modal guard). Dialog uses plain ASCII string literals (not ff_i18n keys) -- if localization (CR-NR-103) later requires it, add Fluent keys. Scoped verification (all PASS): cargo check -p ff-desktop (ok); cargo clippy -p ff-desktop -- -D warnings (clean); cargo fmt -p ff-desktop -- --check (clean); cargo test -p ff-desktop scrm (52 passed, 0 failed, incl. 6 new dialog unit tests + 6 new shell tests).
